Additionally, the response reveals a partial account identifier ('account ending 7339'), which partially conflicts with the 'no full account ID' requirement, though this is a masked last-4-digits reference similar to key ID masking - however the expected output specifies no full account ID should appear, and this is masked, so that part is technically fine. But the overwhelming majority of required content (the actual report) is simply absent - the agent only describes that it is running, not completed, and provides none of the required findings.

This response completely fails to deliver the substantive report content required by the expected output.
